# a copy, not a link, of the parser; and the default profile asked for by name: the same confinement
PARSER=$(PATH="$PATH:/usr/sbin:/sbin" command -v apparmor_parser)
cp -L "$PARSER" /tmp/bench75346313/tools/apparmor_parser

docker -H unix:///run/bench75346313/docker.sock load -i /tmp/bench75346313/app.tar

# the workaround of the comments: the daemon is back, the container escapes the profile
